Skill cooldowns · Prepare → Party attack → Enemy phase

Click a party status card to select a character, then use any ready skills. Details shows full descriptions; Items switches to instant supplies. You can break armor, trigger a fire-and-ice Melt, and heal in the same round. There is no MP: each skill has its own cooldown, reduced only by complete battle rounds. A CD 3 skill used in R1 is ready again in R4.

Press Enter / 1 or click Attack. Each living, unguarded ally attacks once, then enemies act in formation order, not by speed. Press 2 to toggle Guard for the selected ally: 65% less damage this round, but no normal attack. Skills can still be used. Keys 3–7 use skills; [ / ] switch allies.

Healing Tonics, Timesand Drops, and Dispel Salt are finite instant supplies. Using them does not make enemies act or move, or expire statuses. Cooldown-control skills cannot refresh one another; a skill used this round retains at least 1 CD. End-of-round weapon healing triggers only once per round.

Normal packs follow fixed routes and do not automatically chase nearby players. Only a successful alarm by a Moon Herald draws normal packs within 8 path tiles toward the alarm for 6 ticks. Kill or Head Seal the herald to stop it. Elites always track you, one tile per tick. Patrols can also wander into a battle; reinforcements act from the next round.

Press T for tools. Lure Bell leaves a lure for 5 ticks, attracting normal packs within 6 path tiles. Sleep Bell stops a known pack within 4 tiles: 3 ticks for normal packs, 1 for elites. Hush Powder blocks new alarms for 6 ticks. Using tools is free, but movement, waiting, and complete battle rounds reduce their duration. Elites ignore lures. Supplies replenish in limited amounts on descent.

Boss omens give you a full preparation window to dispel, Head Seal, defeat attendants, or land multiple hits. An omen replaces the boss's normal attack that round. Guard when you cannot cancel it. HP triggers reached with skills are announced in a later preparation phase. Bosses grow more dangerous from R13. Battle animations can be skipped; reduced motion disables movement effects without changing outcomes.

W/S move, A/D turn, Q/E strafe, Space wait, F investigate, M map (with explored patrol routes). Play with 1–3 allies across five floors. Weapons are the only equipment, each with one unique effect. Choose Standard, Deliberate, or Fade travel in the menu; the minimap stays north-up. v0.3.3 keeps v0.3 saves; older v0.2 saves are untouched.
